name: GP-EI with shrinking trust region
tagline: After 8 random inits, fits an isotropic-RBF GP (lengthscale grid-MLE), and maximizes EI plus a distance-bonus over a shrinking trust region around the incumbent.
init_recovers: Random search before 8 evals; standard EI when diversity bonus → 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus tpe/bohb/dehb, this is a single-fidelity GP-EI with two additions: a small distance-to-observed bonus on the EI to discourage clumping, and a trust-region candidate distribution whose radius shrinks linearly with progress. No multi-fidelity scheduling.

name: AMFBE: TPE + Hyperband + DE (broken)
tagline: Initializes Hyperband-style brackets seeded by TPE; promotes top-1/eta survivors with DE mutations; submission has IndentationError in suggest().
init_recovers: Pure Hyperband if TPE sampling and DE injection are removed
diff_from_baseline: Combines bohb's TPE-seeded Hyperband with dehb's DE mutations on survivors and an additional adaptive-fidelity heuristic (boost when NN of past configs scored highly). Submission as-stored has indentation errors that prevent execution.

name: RandomForest-UCB + 2-rung successive halving
tagline: Two-rung Hyperband (0.25, 1.0); after 8 evals fits a RandomForest on (encoding, budget) and picks UCB(mean + 1.96·std) of forest predictions over uniform + mutated candidates.
init_recovers: Random search + 2-rung Hyperband if surrogate is bypassed
diff_from_baseline: Versus bohb (TPE+Hyperband) this swaps the TPE density for a RandomForest UCB surrogate and uses only two rungs; versus hyperband it adds the surrogate-driven candidate selection at the low rung.

name: Quantile-calibrated UCB with benchmark-aware mutations
tagline: Detects benchmark family (xgboost/svm/nn), calibrates low-fidelity scores to full-fidelity quantiles, fits a mixed-type kernel surrogate, and uses structure-aware mutations + asynchronous promotion.
init_recovers: Plain UCB if calibration is identity and base_fid≡1
diff_from_baseline: Versus bohb/dehb this hard-codes per-benchmark warm-up and base fidelities, calibrates low-fidelity scores via quantile transport before surrogate fitting, and uses structured (xgboost-aware) mutations rather than uniform DE. The kernel is a hand-built mixed-type weighted-NN regression rather than a GP or TPE.
